name: MiniMax H3
publisher: MiniMax (MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3); ComfyUI repack by Comfy-Org; turbo LoRAs by lightx2v; Fun ControlNet-Union by Alibaba PAI; FastH3 distill by FastVideo

cannot.what: EU, UK or Korea; >$20M yearly revenue needs MiniMax's written authorization
negative prompt or CFG: the released checkpoints are CFG-distilled, the graphs use BasicGuider, 'a negative prompt has no effect' — bans are written as positives

2K output locally: H3-Regenerate-2K is API-only ('not yet open-sourced'); 2K 'needs a separate upscale pass in ComfyUI'. Native canvas is 768 px short edge, capped at the 768x1344 pixel area; 'Frames well above the native canvas do not hold detail'

Context-IR prompt rewriting: H3-Context-IR is 'not included in this open-source release' — prompts must be written in its intermediate-representation format by hand or by an LLM following the official guides
more than ~15 s in one pass: duration 4-15 s, trained frame range ~124-362 ('longer is untested')
FastH3 reference-to-video: the DMD2 distill supports t2va/fl2va only ('Ref2VA ... was not distilled')
sparse attention without CUDA: 'sol-attn' needs the comfy-kitchen sol_attn kernel, otherwise a silent dense fallback
video-to-video restyling through guides: MiniMaxH3AddGuide conditions, it does not seed the latent and denoise does not scale it

community-reported weak spots: faces degrade in wide/medium shots (HF #30); Ref2VA red/blush cheek patches (HF #55, unresolved); voiceover lines get lip-synced onto the visible character (HF #44, unresolved)

params.name: steps
params.meaning: flow-matching denoise steps in one SamplerCustomAdvanced run
params.interactions: 'Shots with simple content hold up at 12 to 16 steps'; 'most of the gain by step 16'; high-frequency detail (chainmail, filigree) 'keep improving up to about 50 steps', below that 'unstable triangular grid artifacts that swim under motion'; 'Audio settles later ... at 8 steps they [speech, timbre] are the weakest part ... 12 steps and above keep the track usable'; references 'ride along every sampling step', so 4-step turbo weakens them. FastH3: exactly 8

params.name: sampler_name
params.interactions: second-order multistep; er_sde is the documented alternative; multistep history 'does not carry over' between two samplers — keep the schedule in one run

params.name: scheduler
params.interactions: R2V template note: 'beta or normal scheduler tends to outperform simple for reference-heavy prompts like this one'

params.name: shift
params.meaning: video shift drives the sampler's sigma schedule (ModelSamplingAV); both values are also handed to the DiT
params.interactions: 'stay near the values that checkpoint is built for: on the distilled 8-step builds, sampling at shift_video 3 instead of 10 shows grid artifacts'

params.name: cfg / negative
params.meaning: there is no CFG and no negative branch: the checkpoints are CFG-distilled
params.interactions: 'a negative prompt has no effect'; 'Keep guidance_scale at 1.0' (ControlNet); write bans as positives

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: canvas in pixels, multiples of 32 (16x VAE x 2x2 latent patch)

defaults.i2v recipes: from the start image at `megapixels` (ImageScaleToTotalPixels, steps of 32)

params.interactions: native canvas: 768 px short edge, capped at the 768x1344 pixel AREA; 'Skip the 1.0 Megapixel step: it yields 1376x768, above the model's 768x1344 pixel area cap'; aspect ratios 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16; 'Frames well above the native canvas do not hold detail'; 'a soft frame is a resolution problem first' — render faces at 1344x768, do not upscale; first_frame is stretched to the canvas, so the canvas must have the image's aspect

params.name: length
params.meaning: frames at 24 fps on the 17k+5 grid (node step 17, min 5, max 3600); latent T = ((frames-5)//17)*5+2; audio latent frames = round(seconds * 40)
params.interactions: grid: 5, 22, 39, ..., 107 (~4.5 s), 124 (5.17 s), 141, ..., 362 (15.1 s); 'trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested'; the templates derive it from seconds as max(5, round(a * 24)) + (5 - (max(5, round(a * 24)) % 17)) % 17; guide clips and control clips are cropped/held to the same grid; one 5090 user reports 30-45 s clips (beyond the trained range)

params.name: fps
params.meaning: the model's native rate; the container must match or the audio track desyncs
params.interactions: fixed by the model (24 fps video, 40 Hz audio latent, 32 kHz stereo)

params.name: seed
params.meaning: the noise seed of the single SamplerCustomAdvanced run

params.name: strength_model
params.interactions: community: 0.6 with er_sde or euler/beta at 6-10 steps (Kijai thread); 2.8 / 4 steps / 1.0 MP 'produces clear faces', 1.8 / 8, 1.0 / 12 (HF #30, single user). The LoRA must match the checkpoint it was distilled on (fl2v <-> fl2va, ref2v <-> ref2va); turbo LoRAs 'carry no adaln tensors, so they load on either build' (pruned or full)

params.name: ref_image_size
params.meaning: how reference images are scaled before encoding
params.interactions: 'match' scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048 px short edge for 'stronger identity fidelity' and 'can be several times slower' since reference tokens ride along every sampling step

params.name: frame_idx
params.meaning: where on the output timeline a guide (still, clip, audio) is anchored, in frames at 24 fps; negative counts from the end
params.interactions: image batches >= 5 frames are cropped DOWN to 17k+5 (5, 22, 39 ...), < 5 frames use the first image; audio is cropped to the remaining duration; 'The index plus the guide length must stay inside the generated length' (the node raises otherwise); guides condition, they do not seed the latent

params.name: strength / start_percent / end_percent
params.meaning: how hard the control skip is added (same role as control_context_scale on the original model) and over which part of sampling
params.interactions: '1.0 is strongest and is what this graph uses. Values below 1.0 loosen the pose. 0 turns the branch off'; 'Raise strength above 1 only if the control drifts'; a control clip longer than length is taken from the start, a shorter one holds its last frame; the control skip is added only to video tokens

params.name: sparse attention
params.input: selection (method), selection.keep_percent | selection.tau, start_percent, end_percent, min_tokens, extra_tokens, sink_conditioning
params.meaning: block-sparse attention over the video tokens for part of the schedule

defaults.fasth3 templates: vsa, keep_percent 10, start 0.2, end 1.0, min_tokens 12288, extra_tokens 256, sink_conditioning exact_kv_and_rows

params.interactions: base weights: 'sol-attn', tau 1.3 default ('1.0 keeps roughly 16% of key blocks exact, 1.5 about 7%, 2.0 about 2.7%'), recommended start ~0.4 / end ~0.9, keep sink_conditioning exact_kv_and_rows, 'Short clips gain little' (min_tokens 12288); needs CUDA + comfy-kitchen sol_attn kernel, else silent dense fallback

params.name: attention backend
params.interactions: Sage Attention 'roughly double the generation speed'; Comfy Kitchen (--use-ck-attention, 0.32.0+) fixes INT8 artifacts 'but crashes with int8-convrot checkpoints' (issue #15529) — use it with the bf16 checkpoints; Sage dtype warnings are expected (affected layers fall back)

params.name: denoise
params.meaning: always 1.0: guides and references condition, they do not seed the latent, so denoise does not scale them; partial regeneration is the mask route (SamplerCustomAdvanced denoise_mask: 0 preserves, 1 regenerates; video masks snap to the 2x2 latent patch grid, audio masks to whole latent frames)

rules.message: H3 text encoding is CLIPLoader with type 'minimax' on the Qwen3-VL-32B encoder; every template sets it
the H3 text encoder is the Comfy-Org Qwen3-VL-32B conversion (nvfp4_awq / int8_convrot / bf16); the nvfp4 file is the template default and 'does not require Blackwell GPU'
H3 decodes video with its own f16t4d24 VAE (minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot or _fp16); no other VAE has the 24-channel latent

the audio half of the joint AV latent needs a second VAELoader with minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors (into VAEDecodeAudio, ReferenceToVideo.audio_vae, AddGuide.audio_vae); the video VAE cannot decode it

H3 generates stereo audio in the same pass; without VAEDecodeAudio -> CreateVideo.audio the clip is silent and the point of the model is lost ('each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent')
the H3 checkpoints are CFG-distilled: no negative branch, cfg must be 1.0 ('a negative prompt has no effect'); the templates use BasicGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced — use that

H3 prompts go into MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.prompt / MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.prompt (the node tokenizes text + images together); a CLIPTextEncode 'negative' is a habit from other families and has no effect here
H3 frame counts sit on the 17k+5 grid at 24 fps (5, 22, 39, ..., 124 = 5 s, ..., 362 = 15 s); the node steps by 17 — 120 is not a legal length, 124 is
'trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested' (4-15 s); the T2V template's 2 s default (56 frames) runs but is below the trained range — 124 (5 s) is what every other template uses
H3 width/height are multiples of 32 (16x VAE times the 1x2x2 latent patch); the nodes step by 32 and the templates' ResolutionSelector uses multiple = 32

the native canvas is a 768 px short edge capped at the 768x1344 pixel AREA (1,032,192 px): 1344x768 is the official 768p, 1376x768 (the 1.0 MP step) is already above the cap; 'Frames well above the native canvas do not hold detail' — for 2K generate native and upscale separately

not one of the sizes the templates and docs use (1344x768 / 768x1344 official 768p; 864x480 / 480x864 / 640x640 = the 0.4 MP preview); any 32-multiple with a 768 short edge inside the 768x1344 area is legal (21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16), but faces and text need the full 768p
H3 generates 24 fps video with a 32 kHz stereo track timed to it; any other container fps changes playback speed and desyncs the audio
every H3 template samples with res_multistep (er_sde is the documented alternative; community turbo tuning also uses euler/beta); other samplers are untested here
with several references the R2V template note prefers 'beta' or 'normal' over 'simple' ('tends to outperform simple for reference-heavy prompts'); simple is what the template ships
the fl2v turbo LoRAs were distilled on the FL2VA checkpoint and the templates load them only there; 'Match an H3 LoRA to the checkpoint build it was distilled on'
the ref2v turbo LoRA belongs on the Ref2VA checkpoint (R2V / Multiframe / ControlNet templates); 'Match an H3 LoRA to the checkpoint build it was distilled on'

'take the pruned build when a repository publishes both'; a LoRA distilled on the FULL build carries adaln weights 'with no matching tensor in the pruned build: ComfyUI reports a shape mismatch for them and does not merge them' — the turbo LoRAs carry no adaln tensors and load on either build
the 8-step turbo LoRA runs at 8 steps in the templates (community: 6-12 with lower strength); 20 steps under it wastes time, 4 under-samples audio
the 4-step turbo LoRAs run at 4 steps in the templates (community: 4-12 with strength 2.8 -> 1.0); 'at 4 steps a reference can end up barely applied' — render the final without the LoRA at 20
FastH3 8-Step V2 is DMD2-distilled for exactly 8 steps
FastH3 needs MiniMaxH3SigmaShift with shift_video 10 / shift_audio 3 (the base model default is 12/3): 'sampling at shift_video 3 instead of 10 shows grid artifacts'
FastH3 supports t2va / fl2va only ('Ref2VA ... was not distilled'): use MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo, not MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
FastH3 is already a distill; its templates load no LoRA and no source covers stacking a turbo LoRA on it
MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply takes the Fun ControlNet-Union patch from ModelPatchLoader (models/model_patches/), not a ControlNetLoader model
the Apply node's vae is the VIDEO VAE ('used to encode the control frames'), not the audio VAE
'1.0 is strongest and is what this graph uses'; 'Raise strength above 1 only if the control drifts'

Ref2VA takes at most 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (2-15 s each, <= 15 s total, >= 5 frames at 24 fps), 3 soundtracks (same-numbered video) and 3 standalone audio clips (2-15 s, <= 15 s total), 12 files in all; slot keys are ref_images.ref_image_N etc., N from 0, contiguous

'<Picture N> tags only bind to images actually connected on ref_images' — ordinals are 1-based per type in CONNECTION order: images first, then videos (each soundtrack's <Audio j> right before its <Video k>), then standalone audio; a tag with no connected input is dangling (the R2V template prompt names <Audio 1> with no audio connected)

'The index plus the guide length must stay inside the generated length' — a still is 1 frame, an image batch is cropped down to 5/22/39/... frames, negative frame_idx counts from the end; the node raises otherwise. Guides chain positive -> positive and the last one feeds BasicGuider

H3 was trained on the H3-Context-IR representation: base prompts carry integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music, reference prompts the six sections subject_definitions / summary / retention_analysis / detailed_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music (see guide.md). The official T2V/I2V templates ship free-form storyboards, so this is a warning; the FastH3 and Multiframe templates use the strict format

docs: Comfy Kitchen attention 'crashes with int8-convrot checkpoints' (issue #15529) — pair it with the pruned_bf16 build; the FastH3 template nevertheless ships it with its int8_convrot file, so treat a crash there as this
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image (FastVideo FastH3: 0.36.0 > 0.35.0; native H3 0.30.0, Add Guide 0.34.0, Fun ControlNet 0.35.0 are fine)

Shot and cut times must sit inside the clip's duration and in order — the official guide lists 'cut times outside or out of order within the duration' among what hurts; a shot timed past the end is never rendered

H3 has no negative prompt; the prompt guide: 'Write bans as positives: a line such as no subtitles and no on-screen text registers text as content. Say what should be in the shot instead' (some official template examples still carry 'Negative: no …' lines — the guide is the explicit statement)

prompting.negative_note: there is NO negative input and no CFG: 'a negative prompt has no effect'. 'Write bans as positives': 'a line such as no subtitles and no on-screen text registers text as content. Say what should be in the shot instead, for example the sign above the door is blank'
prompting.format: H3-Context-IR intermediate representation (the hosted rewriter is not open; write it by hand or with an LLM following the official guides). English throughout, except dialogue/lyrics inside <d> tags and on-screen text, which stay in their original language. guide.md carries the full format with the official examples.

base_instruction_line.i2va: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
base_instruction_line.fl2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot N) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video.
base_instruction_line.l2va: How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot N]) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video.

required_sections.cut_timestamp: At MM:SS.mmm, the camera cuts to ...

positive.line: Base modes (T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA): optional instruction line, blank line, then integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music in that order

Start [Shot 1] with style + initial composition (Cinematic, live-action, 2D-animated, 3D CG, claymation, watercolor, vintage film); no timestamp on Shot 1; later shots '[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to ...' with strictly increasing cut times inside the duration

Camera motion = type + amplitude + speed as prose: 'The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward ...' (Zoom In/Out, Push In/Pull Out, Pan, Truck, Tilt, Pedestal, Arc Shot, Tracking Shot, Static Shot, Shake Slightly/Strongly, POV, Roll)

Speakers get stable IDs (S1), (S2); identity, ID, action and delivery outside the tags, only '<d>[Language] exact words</d>' inside; voiceover = 'says in an off-screen voiceover' + the lips stay closed; <scenetrans> across cuts, <cutoff> for truncated speech; on-screen text in double quotes, verbatim

Reference mode (Ref2VA): six sections; 'Assign each reference a job' (identity, style, motion, camera, voice); label every input <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> in connection order; detailed_description 'normally 350-500 English words'

I2VA keyframe arc: first-frame anchor -> action onset -> continuous development -> result; FL2VA: first-frame state -> observable intermediate changes -> narrowing differences -> last-frame state (single shot preferred); L2VA: plausible preceding state -> explicit transition -> convergence -> last-frame landing
Multiple speakers with audio references can get swapped: tie a line to a visible event rather than a timecode, or supply the line as an audio reference with fully_copy/partially_copy

prompting.structure: base: [instruction line] + integrated_multimodal_description ([Shot 1] ... [Shot 2] At 00:03.500 ...) + overall_soundscape (1-4 sentences, ambient/physical/non-verbal only) + non_diegetic_music (1-3 sentences, instrumentation/tempo/rhythm/dynamics, no mood words; N/A when none). reference: subject_definitions + summary ([task types]) + retention_analysis + detailed_description + overall_soundscape + non_diegetic_music

hurts.line: negative phrasing ('no subtitles') — registers the thing as content
abstract mood words in non_diegetic_music; dialogue or music inside overall_soundscape
<Picture N> tags for images that are not connected (they bind only to connected slots, in order)
cross-dissolve / fade / wipe transitions unless the user asks; cut times outside or out of order within the duration
Ref2VA 'output is very sensitive to prompt wording'

pitfalls.symptom: LoRA shape-mismatch warnings, LoRA partly ignored
pitfalls.cause: a LoRA distilled on the FULL build loaded on a pruned checkpoint (adaln tensors have no match), or a fl2v LoRA on ref2va / ref2v on fl2va
pitfalls.fix: match LoRA to checkpoint; prefer pruned builds; the turbo LoRAs load on either build

pitfalls.symptom: crash ('alignment error') with Comfy Kitchen attention; morphing near the end of a clip or garbled on-screen text with INT8 Sage
pitfalls.cause: comfy-kitchen attention + int8_convrot checkpoint (issue #15529); INT8 Sage artifacts
pitfalls.fix: keep default attention with int8_convrot files, or load pruned_bf16 and switch ModelAttentionBackend to 'comfy kitchen attention' (--use-ck-attention, 0.32.0+)

pitfalls.symptom: 'Input tensors must be in dtype of torch.float16 or torch.bfloat16, using pytorch attention instead'
metallic / underwater audio with the turbo LoRA
pitfalls.fix: run a ComfyUI newer than that (the 0.35.0 image is)

pitfalls.symptom: soft or degraded faces in wide / medium shots
pitfalls.cause: 'a soft frame is a resolution problem first'; 0.4 MP preview canvas; latent re-encode upscalers 'destroy initial details'
pitfalls.fix: generate at 1344x768 (0.98 MP), never the 1.0 MP step; community: turbo LoRA 2.8 / 4 steps at 1.0 MP (single user)

pitfalls.symptom: red / blush cheek patches on Ref2VA output
pitfalls.cause: unresolved (HF #55); appears without LoRAs; more steps did not help
pitfalls.fix: a 'MiniMax-H3-Realism-People' LoRA at 1.0 suppressed it at some resolutions (single report)

pitfalls.symptom: a voiceover line is lip-synced onto the visible character
pitfalls.cause: the guide's 'says in an off-screen voiceover' + closed-lips phrasing is not reliable (HF #44)
pitfalls.fix: name the narrator ('Female narrator voice, saying: ...'), state '<Subject 1>'s lips' stay closed, or supply the line as an audio reference

pitfalls.symptom: reference barely applied; pose or face angle drifts
pitfalls.cause: 4-step turbo LoRA — references ride along every step and 4 is too few
pitfalls.fix: Lightning off (20 steps); 25 if it still drifts; ref_image_size 'max' for identity

pitfalls.symptom: canvas rejected or detail missing at '1.0 MP'
quality drop when sampling is split over two samplers
pitfalls.fix: one SamplerCustomAdvanced for the whole schedule, or enough steps on the second

pitfalls.symptom: 'CUDA error: invalid argument' loading the video VAE on AMD ROCm

pitfalls.cause: needs pytorch with cu130 + comfy-kitchen (community: ComfyUI >= 0.27.0, comfy-kitchen >= 0.2.16); Turing-era GPUs fail
pitfalls.fix: the box's RTX 5090 / RTX PRO 6000 (Blackwell) are fine; otherwise fp8_scaled or pruned_bf16

pitfalls.symptom: H3 generation (or ComfyUI) breaks after an update
pitfalls.cause: the 'ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Cache' custom node 'globally monkey-patches the MiniMax H3 model code'
pitfalls.fix: do not install it (single-source claim; verify before relying)

pitfalls.symptom: guide image seems ignored as a 'video-to-video' source
pitfalls.cause: MiniMaxH3AddGuide conditions, it does not seed the latent; denoise does not scale it
pitfalls.fix: restyle through ref_videos; regenerate parts through the mask route (denoise_mask / ControlNet mask + source_video)

pitfalls.symptom: ValueError on a reference video or guide clip
pitfalls.cause: fewer than 5 frames, or the guide does not fit inside length; reference audio outside 2-15 s
pitfalls.fix: clips >= 5 frames at 24 fps (cropped to 17k+5); frame_idx + guide frames <= length

pitfalls.symptom: out of disk on the 60 GB box
pitfalls.cause: fl2va + ref2va + encoder + VAEs = 61.0 GB; bf16 pruned + encoder = 59.3 GB
pitfalls.fix: one pruned int8 checkpoint at a time (40.1 GB with the encoder and VAEs); ref2va covers t2v (empty refs), r2v, multiframe, control, continuation; fl2va covers t2v / i2v / flf2v

pitfalls.symptom: long waits before the first step
pitfalls.cause: ~15 GB text-encoder load; community: ~3 min for 10 s at 864x480/10 steps on a 5090, 12-13 min HD on a 4090 (bf16)
pitfalls.fix: expected; keep the encoder resident between runs
